# Volkswagen Goa, Nh66, Quelossim — Satellite evidence pack (site SD0016)

**In one line:** not enough clear dry-season images to describe a trend.

## What the imagery shows
- 2021-02-13 (Sentinel-2 L2A, S2B_43PCT_20210213_1_L2A): exposed waste-like 42.51 ha, vegetated 8.13 ha, water 0.74 ha.
- DRAP priority list (MoHUA): legacy waste 1,618,673 t for this site; approved cost ₹0.0 cr.
- Copernicus GLO-30 elevation (2011–2015 epoch): mound up to 27.4 m above surroundings, about 9,327,195 m³.

## Fire record
VIIRS 375 m detected heat at this site on 7 day(s) between 2019-11-19 and 2026-11-11.

## People living nearby
About 20,781 people within 1 km, 31,191 within 2 km and 61,895 within 5 km (GHSL 2025).

## What this evidence cannot tell you
- 10 m imagery measures surface area, not tonnage or height.
- VIIRS misses small and smouldering fires.
- Boundary was auto-traced from satellite data and needs review.
- 4 year(s) excluded for cloud or missing data.
- The relationship between exposed area and total tonnage is indeterminate.

## Suggested next steps for the ULB
- Compare this record with the ULB's own progress data and site survey.
- If heat is detected before summer, check fire-watch arrangements at the site.
- A drone or ground volumetric survey is the only way to confirm remaining tonnage.

## Right of reply
This is an independent evidence pack built from open satellite data, not an official assessment. The ULB and state mission are invited to share official progress data; corrections are published with the date.
